/.name: Home
/.title: Gym management software for Indian gyms
/.description: Vajra Fitness helps gym owners run memberships, fee collection, attendance, trainers and workout plans from one place, and helps members find a gym to join.
/.h1: Run your gym without the paperwork
/.summary: Memberships, fees, attendance, trainers and workout plans for Indian gyms, with a public directory members can browse.

/about.name: About
/about.title: About Vajra Fitness
/about.description: Vajra Fitness is gym management software built for Indian fitness businesses. Learn what the platform does, who it is for and how it handles your data.
/about.summary: Vajra Fitness is software for gyms. Owners run daily operations on it and members use it to find a gym, track their plan and book sessions.

/gyms.name: Gyms
/gyms.title: Find a gym
/gyms.description: Browse gyms listed on Vajra Fitness. Compare cities, facilities and membership plans, then register with the one that suits you.
/gyms.summary: Search approved gyms by city or facility and compare their membership plans.

/membership.name: Membership
/membership.title: How gym membership works
/membership.description: Pick a gym, choose a plan, send your request and start training once the gym approves it. This is how membership works on Vajra Fitness.
/membership.summary: Browse gyms, choose a plan and register. The gym approves your request and you start training.

/subscription.name: Pricing
/subscription.title: Pricing for gym owners
/subscription.description: Platform plans for gym owners, billed monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or yearly. Pay by cash, UPI or card.
/subscription.summary: Plans are billed to the gym, not to its members. Compare limits and features, then pay by cash, UPI or card.

/tools.name: Tools
/tools.title: Free fitness calculators
/tools.description: Free BMI, daily calorie, one-rep max and protein calculators. No sign-up needed and nothing is stored.
/tools.summary: BMI, calorie, one-rep max and protein calculators that run in your browser.

/tools/bmi-calculator.name: BMI calculator
/tools/bmi-calculator.title: BMI calculator
/tools/bmi-calculator.description: Work out your body mass index from height and weight in metric or imperial units, with the WHO category and the Asian cut-offs.
/tools/bmi-calculator.summary: Enter height and weight to get your body mass index and category.

/tools/calorie-calculator.name: Calorie calculator
/tools/calorie-calculator.title: Daily calorie calculator
/tools/calorie-calculator.description: Estimate how many calories you burn each day and how many to eat to lose, hold or gain weight, using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation.
/tools/calorie-calculator.summary: Estimate maintenance calories and a daily target for your goal.

/tools/one-rep-max-calculator.name: One-rep max calculator
/tools/one-rep-max-calculator.title: One-rep max calculator
/tools/one-rep-max-calculator.description: Estimate your one-rep max from the weight and reps of a lighter set, with a table of working weights by percentage.
/tools/one-rep-max-calculator.summary: Estimate your one-rep max from a lighter set and see working weights by percentage.

/tools/protein-calculator.name: Protein calculator
/tools/protein-calculator.title: Daily protein calculator
/tools/protein-calculator.description: Find a daily protein range in grams based on your body weight, activity level and goal.
/tools/protein-calculator.summary: A daily protein range in grams from your weight, activity and goal.

/contact.name: Contact
/contact.title: Contact Vajra Fitness
/contact.description: Send the Vajra Fitness team a message about your gym, a partnership or a problem with your account. We reply by email.
/contact.summary: Use the form to reach the team about a gym listing, a partnership or an account problem.

/help.name: Help
/help.title: Help centre
/help.description: Answers to common questions about memberships, payments, bookings and accounts on Vajra Fitness, and how to reach us when you need more.
/help.summary: Common answers about memberships, payments and accounts, with a link to contact the team.

/faq.title: Frequently asked questions

/faq.summary: Short answers about the platform, pricing, accounts and data.

/terms.summary: The terms that apply when you use Vajra Fitness as a member, trainer or gym owner.
